QuestInfo.name: [Home] Amy's Juice Craze
QuestInfo.0: You went to all the trouble of going to Gold Beach Resort to pick up some Tropical Fruit Juice for Amy, but she insists it doesn't taste the way she remembes.
QuestInfo.1:
Amy's decided she'll just reproduce the juice from scratch. She's tasked you with gathering ingredients.

You can get #bSunrise Dew#k from the General Stores #bin major towns#k and #bIce#k from enemies in #bEl Nath's Ice Valley#k.
QuestInfo.2: Amy spent the whole day juicing, but wasn't able to reproduce the taste from her childhood. But when the townspeople tried it, they discovered it was actually quite delicious!

1.msg: #h0#, I'll gather the fruit. Please bring me #t2020014# x10 and #t4036671# x10.\r\nYou can get #t2020014# from the General Store in major towns and #t4036671# from enemies in El Nath's Ice Valley.
